artifacts.summary: Rules the /slice design: neither existing builder is promoted, review-stack-prepare.sh and /merge are removed, review_base is dropped for a prompted target, and the size bar is measured per target; corrects the description's premise that the sf1-engine builder has opened pull requests.

memory_candidates.content: A repository's merged-pull-request count is not evidence that a local slice-building tool works. Before crediting a builder with production use, check that its own ref namespace exists on the remote (git for-each-ref refs/remotes) and who authored the merged pull requests (gh pr list --json author,headRefName,mergedBy). In sf1-engine the 19 merged pull requests were 18 by the remote owner from hand-made branches; the builder had pushed nothing.

Push grants are matched against git rev-parse HEAD at consume time (push-grant-lib.sh), not against the commit of the ref being pushed. For a ref built by plumbing and never checked out, any commit by any session inside the 600-second window invalidates the grant, and the grant does not pin the pushed content.

claim_invalidations.claim: The sf1-engine builder has opened 22 pull requests, of which 18 merged.
